        <ArticleTitle>Microglial TREM2 activation restores cognitive deficits and reduces amyloid pathology.</ArticleTitle>
        <Abstract>
          <AbstractText Label="BACKGROUND">Microglial dysfunction is a hallmark of Alzheimer's disease pathogenesis.</AbstractText>
          <AbstractText Label="RESULTS">Here we demonstrate that activating TREM2 via monoclonal agonist antibodies enhances microglial phagocytosis of amyloid beta peptide and reduces plaque deposition in 5xFAD mice.</AbstractText>
          <AbstractText Label="CONCLUSIONS">Targeting TREM2 represents a promising immunotherapeutic approach for neurodegeneration.</AbstractText>
        </Abstract>
